overall_summary: Data clearly shows that complex poetic shayari or general life lessons perform poorly (21-150 views), whereas deep-rooted relationship dynamics and family/partner realities (specifically husband-wife and romantic understanding) are massive outliers driving 1,600+ views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,679 views) heavily outperform everything else.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship compromises, unspoken marital bonds, and love post-marriage.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a direct observation or situational truth (e.g., 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' at 392 views) outpace vague poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, grounded relationship statements as hooks instead of high-level philosophical quotes.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or cryptic shayari titles. Keep the language natural and spoken.

weak_patterns.evidence: First upload of the sister video got 19 views (though re-uploaded did slightly better, the core topic is weaker than marital bonds).
weak_patterns.action: Prioritize husband-wife and deep emotional relationship dynamics over general family compilation tropes.
